    Frequently Asked Questions

    question_mark

    When will I get it?

    Most customers receive theirs within 6–12 business days, with 3 tracking updates along the way. We ship from the closest location available to get it to you faster.

    question_mark

    Are there any extra fees or tariffs?

    No — we currently cover all customs fees and import tariffs for you — but we can’t guarantee how long this policy will last, especially with rising shipping and import costs. Order now to lock in today’s price.

    question_mark

    I bought a similar bag on Amazon and felt scammed — why is yours better?

    Unlike cheap Amazon knockoffs, CrushKit is built to last. It uses premium, water-resistant fabric, reinforced stitching, and smooth, durable zippers. The internal layout is thoughtfully designed to hold full-size bottles, keep items upright, and separate wet and dry — no flimsy dividers, no shortcuts.

    question_mark

    Is CrushKit too big for short trips?

    No — while it holds a lot, CrushKit compresses easily when not fully packed. It works just as well for weekend getaways as it does for long trips, without feeling bulky in your suitcase.

    question_mark

    Will CrushKit fit full-size toiletries?

    Yes. CrushKit is designed specifically to fit full-size shampoo, conditioner, body wash, skincare bottles, and makeup, all without squeezing or leaking.

    question_mark

    How much does it hold?

    It comfortably fits toiletries, skincare, makeup, brushes, medications, and accessories — all in one place. Many customers replace 2–3 separate pouches with a single CrushKit.

    question_mark

    Does it separate wet and dry items?

    Yes. CrushKit features smart internal divisions with water-resistant lining, allowing you to safely separate wet items (like bottles or wipes) from dry essentials.

    question_mark

    Are the materials durable for frequent travel?

    Absolutely. CrushKit is made with premium, easy-to-clean fabric, reinforced seams, and sturdy zippers designed to withstand frequent packing, unpacking, and long trips.

    question_mark

    Can I use the CrushKit for travel and everyday life?

    Yes — CrushKit is designed for both travel and everyday use. It’s perfect for trips, but also works just as well at home to keep your bathroom, vanity, or gym bag organized. Many customers leave it out daily and only zip it up when it’s time to go.

    question_mark

    Are the colors true to what I see online?

    Yes — photographed in natural light for an accurate, true-to-life look.

    question_mark

    How fast do popular colors sell out?

    Some colors are so loved they sell out in just a few days — Our last restock sold out in under a week — if you see your favorite in stock, grab it now.

    question_mark

    Can I return or exchange it?

    Yes — shop risk-free with 90-day returns, a local return address, and fast refunds (processed within 48h after scan)
